# Secure Coding (OWASP)

## Purpose

Reduce security risks by following OWASP secure coding practices.

## Instructions

- Validate all user input and sanitize outputs.
- Use parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection.
- Store secrets securely and do not hard-code credentials.
- Handle errors and exceptions securely.
- Regularly update dependencies and monitor for vulnerabilities.

## References

- See OWASP Top 10 and project README.md for more details.
